summary: Iteration 102: P0 (Mollie payment cleanup + calorie incoherence fix) and P1 (V6 bracelet BLE integration) testing completed. All 17 backend tests pass. Fixed missing timedelta import in health_report_routes.py that was causing 500 error on /api/health/daily-report.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: health_report_routes.py was missing 'timedelta' import causing 500 error on /api/health/daily-report
contract_routes.py: Mollie migration complete - no more Stripe dependencies (subscription.id NameError fixed)
contract_routes.py: PLANS dict has 4 plans internally but GET /api/plans returns only 2 (bracelet, bracelet_gilet) - intended behavior
bracelet_routes.py: V6 BLE config has all 8 services correctly defined
bracelet_routes.py: V6 push endpoint properly updates device status and stores consolidated readings
glycemia_routes.py: Uses bracelet device_readings for estimation, V6 data is correctly fetched
bracelet-connect.tsx: V6 detection works via device name prefix matching, subscribes to all standard GATT services

success_rate.frontend: N/A - Onboarding flow prevents direct page access, but bracelet-connect page loads correctly

seed_data_creation: V6 test data pushed via API tests (heart_rate=72, spo2=97, ppg samples)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 102 verified: (1) GET /api/plans returns 2 plans, (2) GET /api/stripe/config returns provider='mollie', (3) POST /api/contract/create works without crashing, (4) POST /api/mollie/webhook handles form data, (5) POST /api/webhook/stripe returns deprecation message, (6) GET /api/health/daily-report works after timedelta fix, (7) GET /api/bracelet/v6/config returns 8 services, (8) POST /api/bracelet/v6/push accepts all data types, (9) GET /api/bracelet/status reflects V6 data, (10) GET /api/bracelet/v6/ppg-history returns stored data, (11) GET /api/glycemia/estimate uses V6 bracelet data. Frontend bracelet-connect page loads and shows V6 support in UI.
